lines.text: Hello, tech enthusiasts! Welcome to SytronSoft.
Smarter cameras. Intelligent recognition. Real-world automation.
Here's our ANPR system in action!
The camera watches the road. SytronANPR locks on to every number plate in view.
Single or double line, Indian plates are read in real time.
Every read lands in the dashboard, with the plate, the vehicle type and the time.
It tells cars, buses, trucks, two-wheelers and autos apart.
Day, night, rain or glare, it keeps reading.
An instant email alert arrives, with the plate image.
And the barrier opens only for whitelisted plates.
Reports follow by email, daily or weekly, as PDF, Word or CSV.
SytronANPR. Read every plate, track every vehicle, control every gate. Visit www.sytronsoft.com.
